subject: spanish
promptStrong: Give me a 40-word writing task in Spanish on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, then mark my answer for accuracy and range.
promptWeak: Give me a two-way translation drill (Spanish↔English) on {lo} for {board} {level} {subject}, with answers and the common mistakes to avoid.

questions.q: What does 'seguir a un influencer en las redes sociales' mean?
options: To follow an influencer on social media
questions.explain: 'Seguir' means 'to follow', so this means 'to follow an influencer on social media'.
“La Semana Santa” literally “Holy Week” is the Easter celebration with processions.

questions.q: How do you say “I prefer subtitles to dubbing”?
options: Prefiero los subtítulos a la pantalla
Prefiero el doblaje a los subtítulos
questions.explain: “Los subtítulos” = subtitles and “el doblaje” = dubbing: “Prefiero los subtítulos al doblaje”.

questions.q: How do you say “The flight was cancelled because of the weather”?
options: El vuelo salió a causa del tiempo
El vuelo se cancela a causa del tiempo
El vuelo se canceló a causa del tiempo
El viaje se canceló a causa del tiempo
questions.explain: “El vuelo” = the flight, “se canceló” = was cancelled and “a causa del tiempo” = because of the weather.
“La aduana” means “customs”, where bags may be checked when crossing a border.

questions.q: How do you say 'I would like to book a double room'?
options: Me gusta reservar una habitación doble
Me gustaría reservar una habitación doble
Me gustaría reservar una habitación individual
Me gustaría recordar una habitación doble
questions.explain: 'Reservar' = 'to book' and 'doble' = 'double'; 'recordar' (to remember) is a near-miss distractor.

questions.q: Which sentence means “The whole family gets together to have dinner”?
options: Toda la familia se reúne para comer
Toda la familia se reúne para desayunar
Toda la familia se reúne para cenar
Todo la familia se reúne para cenar
questions.explain: “Reunirse” = to get together and “cenar” = to have dinner: “Toda la familia se reúne para cenar”.
“El desfile” means “a parade/procession”, common during Spanish festivals.

questions.q: How do you say 'I spent two weeks on the coast'?
options: Pasé dos semanas en la montaña
Pasé dos semanas en la costa
Paso dos semanas en la costa
Pasaré dos semanas en la costa
questions.explain: 'Pasé' is the preterite 'I spent' and 'la costa' = 'the coast', so the first option is correct.

questions.q: What is celebrated in Spain on 'el Día de los Reyes Magos' (6 January)?
options: The Three Kings / Epiphany, when children get presents
questions.explain: 'Los Reyes Magos' are the Three Kings; on 6 January Spanish children traditionally receive their presents.
'La Nochebuena' (24 December) means 'Christmas Eve'; 'la Nochevieja' is New Year's Eve.

questions.q: Which sentence means “The internet keeps me informed”?
questions.explain: “Mantener informado” = “to keep informed”, so “Internet me mantiene informado”.

questions.q: What does “el equipaje de mano” mean?
questions.explain: “El equipaje” = luggage and “de mano” = hand, so “el equipaje de mano” = “hand luggage”.

questions.q: Which means “I'd recommend visiting the old town”?
questions.explain: “El casco antiguo” means “the old town”, and “recomendaría” is the conditional “I'd recommend”.
